_about: v1.204.0 — the recorded plant 2026-08-21..2026-11-06 (the snapshot ends 2026-11-06 18:03:40 site time), reduced to what the panel-measured solar basis reads: per slot-hour [startMs, sun, pct0, pct1, outWh, inWh, acInS, fieldWh, fieldCovS, frozen, coreRawWh, coreCovS] built by panelPvBasis.buildSlotHours from the raw rows exactly as the worker reads them (panel series raw from 1 h before the day, each Core's pv_total in 60-s buckets); the energy bridge's windows per day [slot, Core, basis, count]; the vendor's daily solar (Wh); the slots whose field the bridge trusts; the days a G11 charge proof was found.
